scope: complete eight-building E4 family, wagon, trough, and ratifiable accessory pack

cadence.accretion: PERSIST E3 festoon; RELIC older steam fittings; REPLACE arc anchors with exhaust anchors
cadence.justification: Motor travel directly creates the drive-through inn.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST E3 orrery/grid hardware; RELIC older steam fittings; REPLACE arc anchors with exhaust anchors
cadence.justification: Vehicle engineering plausibly grows its drafting wing and wind gauge.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST shop shell and electric loading service; RELIC steam fittings; REPLACE arc anchors with exhaust anchors
cadence.justification: A frontier store becomes the public motor-supply and service point.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST civic shell and grid feed; RELIC steam fittings; REPLACE arc anchors with exhaust anchors
cadence.justification: Motor roads create permits, route boards, and vehicle registration.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST electrical laboratory gear; RELIC steam apparatus; REPLACE arc anchors with exhaust anchors
cadence.justification: Fuel quality and oil samples give the assay lab a direct Motor-era job.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST chapel, cross, and prior wiring; RELIC cold steam hardware; REPLACE active arc seam with no E4 emitter
cadence.justification: Motors barely touch worship: one parking rail and an old oil stain, with no active exhaust fixture.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST electric drive; RELIC steam-era plant; REPLACE arc anchors with exhaust anchors
cadence.justification: Industrial motors directly alter the mill's drive and service yard.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST the E3 grid crown; RELIC steam header; REPLACE arc anchors with exhaust anchors
cadence.justification: The grid now supplies motors and gains a public Motor Works function.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST wagon shell; RELIC E2 fittings and E3 voltage terminal; REPLACE arc anchor with exhaust anchor
cadence.justification: A wedge bonnet, cab window, headlamp, and light-dust exhaust turn the wagon into a playful compact motor caravan.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST trough shell; RELIC capped E2/E3 feed and pump; REPLACE active arc seam with no E4 emitter
cadence.justification: Horse infrastructure fades instead of becoming a motor appliance.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST E3-era street lighting; no E4 replacement
cadence.justification: Motors do not relight a street.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST canonical flat walk geometry; NEW E4 split compacted gate lanes
cadence.justification: Motors pave paired entrance lanes around the inherited horse-trough relic while the plaza stays open.

cadence.accretion: PERSIST wire runs, insulator posts, and transformer shed; arc effects stay cold in E4
cadence.justification: The electrical grid still serves the town even when its era effect is dormant.

cadence.accretion: RELIC coal bin, pipe run, gauge post, and manifold; steam effects stay cold
cadence.justification: Motor infrastructure supersedes their public-era role without erasing the town's history.
The posts outlive the horse traffic they served.

cadence.fixture: Fences, well, notice board, and planters
cadence.justification: Motor technology has no believable reason to rebuild ordinary civic furniture.

cadence.fixture: Fuel racks, road markers, and filling shed
cadence.justification: Fuel and marked motor routes are the accessory pack's ensemble-level Motor announcement.
The Town changes around its permanent through-line.

chapel.method: cadence-approved quiet fixture; ensemble owns the era read
